rollout_ideas.methodology_footer: Health Foresight rollout recommender v1: catalog archetypes + claims concentration + Jaccard/code-coverage dedup vs in-force policies + optional tenant elasticity models.

recommendations.title: Prior authorization — advanced outpatient imaging
recommendations.summary: High unit cost and discretionary scheduling make imaging a standard UM lever; evidence of volume or spend concentration supports staged rollout.

estimated_impact.confidence_explanation: Large claim volume in the lookback window.
estimated_impact.elasticity_note: Industry-typical elasticity band for this archetype (no tenant-specific elasticity model).

recommendations.title: Site-of-care steerage — hospital vs free-standing infusion
recommendations.summary: Infusion often shows site price dispersion; members can be steered with network design and benefit design.

estimated_impact.confidence_explanation: Moderate volume; estimates should be validated with a pilot or sensitivity analysis.
estimated_impact.elasticity_note: Industry-typical elasticity band for this archetype (no tenant-specific elasticity model).

recommendations.title: Step therapy — specialty pharmacy / biologic sequence
recommendations.summary: Specialty drug spend is concentrated; step protocols are common where PBM data aligns.

estimated_impact.confidence_explanation: Moderate volume; estimates should be validated with a pilot or sensitivity analysis.
estimated_impact.elasticity_note: Industry-typical elasticity band for this archetype (no tenant-specific elasticity model).

recommendations.title: Urgent care / convenience access — ED avoidable utilization
recommendations.summary: When ED-coded urgent care appears in claims, benefit and steerage can shift lower-acuity volume.

estimated_impact.confidence_explanation: Moderate volume; estimates should be validated with a pilot or sensitivity analysis.

recommendations.title: Laboratory — high-volume panel optimization
recommendations.summary: Routine lab panels drive claim volume; modest UM or network tiering can reduce low-value repeats.

estimated_impact.confidence_explanation: Moderate volume; estimates should be validated with a pilot or sensitivity analysis.
estimated_impact.elasticity_note: Industry-typical elasticity band for this archetype (no tenant-specific elasticity model).

rollout_ideas.note: Rollout recommender proposes net-new catalog archetypes after dedup vs in-force book. The nine mock policies are already in-force, so ideas are adjacent gaps (e.g. advanced imaging PA, infusion steerage), not duplicates of the nine.

sign_convention.payment_impact: Payer savings = baseline_paid − post_policy_paid. Positive means the payer pays less (provider receives less).
sign_convention.delta_payment_impact: Incremental payer savings vs base scenario. Positive = additional payer savings (not increased provider payment).
sign_convention.volume_effect: Change attributable to units/volume; 0 when volume held constant.
sign_convention.price_effect: Change attributable to unit price / payment rules.
sign_convention.mix_effect: Change attributable to service/site mix shifts.
